summary: Well-executed, fully preregistered paired confirmatory run that transparently reports a degenerate (ceiling) outcome under shared_initial_candidate semantics. Methodology, preregistration fidelity, execution accounting, and archival provenance are thorough and artifact-grounded. The paper’s principal scientific limitation is the uninformative confirmatory result (no discordant pairs), which the authors correctly diagnose and explain. The manuscript is otherwise sound but requires a small set of manuscript revisions (bibliography formatting and a minor provenance clarification) before finalisation.
critical_issues: References are not presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with full, verified bibliographic metadata; the submitted manuscript uses inline/placeholder citation strings rather than a formal References section (terminal_bibliographic_records is empty). This violates the submission requirements for an IEEE-style bibliography and prevents independent verification that each cited record supports the nearby scholarly claim.
required_revisions: Replace the current citation placeholders/cited_record_ids with a conventional, numbered IEEE-style References section containing full bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year, and DOI/arXiv identifier where available) for every work cited in the paper. Ensure the in-text citations use the corresponding IEEE numeric markers and that each cited record actually supports the claim it is attached to (use the archived verification records to confirm support).

Add one concise, explicit sentence in Methods stating that execution/model_configuration.json records temperature = null (temperature unset) and that null/unset is not evidence of deterministic provider-side sampling, and reiterate that exactly one sampled initial generation per pair was reused by both arms under the preregistered shared_initial_candidate semantics (this must match the archived model_configuration.json and deterministic_reconciliation artifacts).
optional_revisions: (Optional) In Methods or Disclosure, briefly note that full verified reference records used to assemble the References section are preserved in the archived evidence bundle and provide the (already-included) preregistration identifier for cross-checking rather than including internal artifact paths or additional hashes in the prose.

(Optional) Add a short clarifying sentence in Results pointing readers to the archived analysis CSVs (e.g., paired_contingency_table.csv and condition_summary.csv) for reproducibility; keep wording high-level and avoid inserting internal file paths or raw hashes into the manuscript body (the archive already preserves them).
